description: Planted-fault QA fixture specs (WP40, design section 20 Phase 3 exit criteria): a different number in an exact span, a head insertion, a render cut by the token cap and an unplaceable cue, which must be caught; and per cent heard as percent, nought heard as zero and one slip in a three-word title, which must pass. Specs only, no audio.
